textures.name: Spacebar-ClearGlass
textures.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production World of Warcraft statusbar fill texture, not a mockup. Create one extremely wide horizontal rectangular material strip, 1024 pixels wide and 128 pixels tall, front orthographic view. The strip fills the entire image edge to edge, with square ends and no margins, border frame, external shadow, surrounding scene, text, icons, numbers, UI, watermark, or perspective. Neutral grayscale only, no color cast, intended to be tinted by the game. Lighting and depth should vary primarily from top to bottom and stay consistent left to right; no diagonal reflections or decorative patterns. Extremely clean professional game UI material, smooth continuous gradients that remain readable when scaled down to a 256 by 32 pixel bar. Do not show a checkerboard pattern.
Material: clear optical glass. Genuine semitransparent cool-neutral body, a very fine near-white highlight along the upper edge, a delicate secondary lower glint, and a broad subtle curved reflection in the upper quarter. The center remains visibly translucent with very light grey glass shading. Crisp rim lighting provides the depth, without a thick outline. Elegant restrained clear glass.
textures.final_edit_prompt: Edit this production statusbar texture. Keep only ONE clear-glass rectangular material tile and make that tile occupy the ENTIRE canvas, from top to bottom and from left to right. Remove the duplicated lower panel and every outside shadow, irregular transparent fragment, and surrounding empty area. One uninterrupted glass surface, never two stacked bars. The exact canvas edges are the glass edges. A fine bright rim on the top and bottom, soft broad upper reflection, and a consistent translucent pale gray center. Genuine evenly semi-transparent center, approximately 60 percent opacity, with crisp more-opaque highlights. All horizontal rows should run continuously across the full width. Square ends. Neutral grayscale. No outside space, checkerboard, noise, text, frame, or perspective. This is a clean texture map that will be compressed vertically into a very thin UI bar.
